facts.text: Andrew sent a photo of Toby to Audrey.

evidence.quote: Andrew: Yep, Audrey. Thanks for everything - you rock! Here's a pic of Toby. [image: a photo of a small dog sitting on a floor with a leash]

facts.text: Audrey expressed affection for Toby's happiness in the photo.

evidence.quote: Audrey: Aww so cute! Toby looks happy!
Andrew: Haha yeah, I do love Toby!

facts.text: Audrey expressed optimism about Toby's future adventures.

evidence.quote: Audrey: I'm glad Toby is happy. I'm sure there are lots of adventures to come!
